purpose: Partial Zagreb residential developer roster with independently checked own-site role evidence; a discovery entry is not a licence for media republication.
source: Company project portfolios, Lankea discovery directory, and historical HUP board leads; no current HUP membership assertion.

records.name: GIP Pionir
records.verification_basis: The company identifies residential construction for the Zagreb market as its core activity.

records.name: Mešić COM
records.verification_basis: Own company and sales pages describe investment, construction and sale of apartments in Zagreb.

records.name: KSO Gradnja
records.verification_basis: The company advertises its own Zagreb residential developments and completed Zdihovska, Blato and Lukoranska projects.

records.name: VMD Grupa
records.verification_basis: Its project page identifies the Park Kneževa residential and commercial development in Zagreb. HUP discovery evidence is explicitly the historical 2020–2024 board.

records.name: IMAG
records.verification_basis: The company describes development from land acquisition through commercialization and lists Zagreb residential references; these references do not establish current apartment availability.

records.name: Landmark Group
records.verification_basis: Its own portfolio identifies the Prečko Zapad 5 residential development and Savska Opatovina apartment building.

records.name: Privium
records.verification_basis: The company portfolio identifies residential development and the five-apartment Srebrnjak building.

records.name: Nobel Grupa
records.verification_basis: The official construction site markets apartments directly from the investor and identifies residential projects in Zagreb.

records.name: MADO
records.verification_basis: The official site identifies its Franc residential quarter in Zagreb. This record makes no legal-entity continuity claim about the former Alfa Stan brand.

records.name: BHB Domus
records.verification_basis: The company identifies its residential and business development at Heinzelova and Branimirova in Zagreb.

records.name: Palace / Novogradnja Zagreb
records.verification_basis: The company describes development of its own residential projects as investor and contractor and publishes Zagreb project offers.

records.name: Orven Capital
records.verification_basis: The official development portfolio identifies Ilica 255 in Zagreb as a mixed-use project with seven apartments.
